strengths_deep_dive: Support Life Foundation demonstrates financial commitment to direct service, directing <cite id="1">96.6% of expenses to programs in FY2024</cite> [1]. This program expense ratio easily exceeds the 87.7% peer median and the 75% sector benchmark [1]. In addition, fundraising efficiency is excellent, requiring <cite id="1">less than <$0.01 per $1 raised</cite> [1]. The organization maintains transparency by achieving a Platinum Seal on Candid and meeting <cite id="1">all 20 BBB Wise Giving Alliance standards</cite> [1].
rich_narrative.summary: Support Life Foundation is a community-based organization focused on social and economic justice through food distribution, education, and social programs [3]. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="2">$1,078,197 in total revenue</cite>, which reflects a 12% revenue decline from $1,228,678 in FY2023 [2]. Operations remain lean, directing <cite id="1">96.6% of expenses to program activities</cite> like the YANA Community Food Share and Project Educate [1][3]. While earlier growth drove a 36.8% multi-year revenue CAGR from 2022 to 2023, recent revenue contraction highlights the need for a stable donor base [2]. Donations to Support Life Foundation are <cite id="4">sadaqah-eligible</cite>, supporting local communities across the San Francisco Bay Area and Stockton [3][4].
